conventions.name: Project Wiki
conventions.description: Maintain a .wiki/ of durable codebase knowledge (gotchas, decisions, glossary), in-tree or out-of-tree.

conventions.name: Orchestrator Wiki
conventions.description: Maintain the conductor's machine-local .conduct/wiki/ of global, per-workspace and per-project conducting knowledge.

tools.name: read_index
tools.description: The conductor wiki's index pages for a scope set. Always includes the root `index.md` and `global/index.md`; `project` and `workspace` each add their own index, and `project` also adds the index of the workspace it belongs to. A requested scope with no page yet is reported as missing — a normal answer, not a failure.

project.description: Project whose projects/<name>/index.md to include, plus the index of the workspace it belongs to.

workspace.description: Workspace whose workspaces/<name>/index.md to include. Use when reading across a workspace without naming one of its projects.

wikiRoot.description: Absolute path of the conductor wiki root; every path below is relative to it.

resolvedWorkspace.description: The workspace the host reports for `project`, verbatim; null when no project was given or it could not be resolved.

indexes.description: The index pages that exist, broad to narrow (root, global, workspace, project), each at most once.

name.description: The workspace or project name; null for root and global.

missing.description: Posix paths, relative to wikiRoot, of requested index pages that do not exist or could not be read.
